[[File:Blastwave.jpg|thumb|200px|Force Shockwave]]
'''Force Shockwave''', also known as '''Focus Shockwave '''or '''Force Bomb''',<ref name="ROTS game">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref> was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to emit a powerful destructive ring of energy, damaging or destroying anything in its radius.

The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was a practitioner of this technique during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="ROTS game" />

[[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] also released a similar massive Force pulse against large group of battle droids, eliminating all of them and knocking [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and Kenobi aside.<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>
